reviews.title: It collects your data, controls freedom of speech, and has a biased and discriminatory agenda
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for years and have now realized how much it has changed. I thought it was just some technical issues but I’m now convinced that it’s political and social. 

This app is now at the point of being invasive, collecting your data, (even purchases and searches), and controlling your freedom of speech, (even selectively deleting and not allowing you to save certain creations that don’t line up with its political and social agenda/playbook/project). 

This app-maker has sold out; therefore, I won’t be renewing my subscription.

reviews.title: Convenient and fast but
reviews.text:
I pay because it is convenient. I do have a problem with how photos from the iPhone lose a lot of quality once through mematic. Bright sharp photos become dulled. 
Brightest areas become darker and photos lose their zing. 
Not crazy about this bug, applies only to the higher quality photos.

reviews.title: It’s Ok for Fluff memes
reviews.text:
🙀🙀🙀It is too easy to delete a project if you change the layout- even after I saved project- it disappeared.

If you change the layout in the middle of project - it will delete your project!! 😫🤬If you want to overlap pictures or dialogue boxes it’s difficult.  If you want to make Cutesy stuff this is great as the stock photos seem limited to a CUTE CULTURE Vocabulary.
Not great for making Awareness memes as those are not usually ‘cute’ images

reviews.title: Garbage app forces purchases
reviews.text: This app is junk. The authors make using it as a free app completely impossible, constantly plastering the screen with demands to upgrade for $30/year. I want to try the app for simple memes before buying. Have bought enough apps that turn out to be trash that I will not fork over money until I can see that the app works and does what I want. Do not waste your time with this rubbish app. Try others.
